title: I'm tired because I went to sleep too late.
scene: 走路拖着脚，又累又无聊。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You're dragging your feet today. Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'm tired because I went to sleep too late.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You did stay up past your bedtime, didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And I'm bored too. This walk is so long.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Are you more bored, or more tired?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Both! Because walking makes my legs sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then how about a piggyback ride to the corner?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes please! My legs say thank you!
